comment: The embedded T3 server: the official T3 Code CLI release archive (Node single executable), the release nearest the reference pin 74541bab17 whose version is not older than CLIENT_VERSION (version-skew.ts). Its commit precedes the pin by 71 commits, six of them server changes. stage-runtime.mjs downloads it, checks it against SHA256SUMS and this hash, and puts it beside this file; the app unpacks it into <T3 home>/runtime/versions/<version> at first launch.
